description: The original 24fps looping composer animation with alpha, resized to 180x320 for browser-independent image decoding at up to 3x its CSS size.
conversion: ffmpeg -c:v libvpx-vp9 -i minimax-octopus-composer.webm -vf scale=180:320 -c:v libwebp_anim -quality 85 -compression_level 6 -loop 0 -an minimax-octopus-composer.webp
